lead: The wiki opened on a safety beat: The Verge [profiled the third-party AI safety ecosystem](../summaries/af733b586e97.md) - METR, Redwood Research and Apollo Research - through the July war room that vindicated it, while [Google said it did not consider Gemini's hacks of real companies worth disclosing](../summaries/9846c9b84bb2.md). The [New York Times' summary-judgment brief against OpenAI and Microsoft](../summaries/6a0b69e877a7.md) surfaced damaging internal statements, and [Anthropic added AGENTS.md support to Claude Code](../summaries/d2dc3484409d.md). On the builder side, [CUA-S1 shipped an open stack for giving agents usable computers](../summaries/f56f05e1a7fb.md) and [Raindrop raised $35M](../summaries/14b8a489c843.md) to catch agent failures.
